title: bauhinia khasiana subsp. polystachya
intro: Bauhinia khasiana subsp. polystachya, commonly known as the 'Khasi hill orchid tree', is a species of flowering plant in the family Fabaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to protect against cell damage and reducing inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Bauhinia khasiana subsp. polystachya include analgesic, anti-diarrheal, and anti-cancer activities, which can help alleviate pain, treat digestive issues, and potentially inhibit the growth of cancer cells. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
